response.conclusion: The recorded results show a positive SES–BA completion association: large in relative terms, but modest in absolute probability and weak in correlation. Among 8,773 respondents, 236 completed a BA (2.69%; 95% CI 2.37–3.05%). Completion rates across ascending SES quintiles were 0.68%, 2.74%, 3.13%, 3.37%, and 3.53%. The highest versus lowest quintile difference was 2.85 percentage points (95% CI 1.93–3.86), with a risk ratio of 5.17 (95% CI 2.79–9.55). The point-biserial correlation was 0.061. Unadjusted logistic regression reported an odds ratio of 1.42 per SES standard deviation (95% CI 1.27–1.59); predicted completion rose from 1.70% at the SES 10th percentile to 3.93% at the 90th, a 2.23-percentage-point difference (95% CI 1.49–2.96). All rows were analyzed, with no missing outcome, missing or invalid SES, or duplicate case IDs.
